errors.text: The proposed materials are not the target AuCoCuNiPt nanoparticles, so the element-specific Au/Cu surface segregation, shell melting, and evaporation mechanism cannot be reconstructed or tested.

The predicted dominant outcome is spinodal decomposition or separation into elemental phases, whereas the target behavior is surface-energy-driven Au/Cu segregation followed by melting and evaporation, without evidence that bulk spinodal decomposition is the governing pathway.
The asserted sharp critical temperature and approximate 700–800 K stability window are not supported by the cited evidence; activated diffusion generally need not produce a sharp threshold.

The cited papers mainly establish synthesis routes and selected catalytic or annealing stability observations, not the claimed diffusion barriers, intrinsic kinetic trapping, size-dependent critical temperature, or segregation mechanism.
